pr_title: Complete ADR 0124 production navigation first release
pr_body:
Complete ADR 0124 on current main. This follow-up adds the dedicated production Navigation window with bake/currentness status, editable agent profiles, Bake/Rebuild/Cancel controls, path testing, and Scene View path visualization while preserving the existing engine-owned NavMesh overlay and backend-neutral public contracts.
